fact: The man in charge for the club's first league match of 2026-27. appointed is the month his stint began (YYYY-MM), stored only where two reads on two different registrable domains print the same month and no read prints another. An interim made permanent has two months for one stint (the interim start and the permanent deal), so such a chair is name only.
spelling: The stored name is the form the club's own site prints (R5), with the accents exactly as the club prints them; the case may differ where a club sets names in capitals. Each chair's spelling read names that page. Hosts are compared with each other only after accent folding.
